_comment: PH mall operators investigated 2026-07-26 that are NOT scraped, with the reason. Recorded so the absence is a documented finding rather than an oversight. Re-check periodically: a site redesign may add a directory.

chains.name: CityMall (DoubleDragon)
chains.finding: citymall.com.ph is a thin DoubleDragon corporate shell; /citymall_map returns a 423-byte stub. DoubleDragon reported 43 operating CityMalls at end-2024 with a target of 100 by 2030. These are small community malls anchored by a supermarket; no per-mall tenant directory is published on any official domain found.
chains.recheck: Branch list could be assembled from DoubleDragon investor disclosures / Wikipedia if mall-level coverage is wanted.

chains.name: Gaisano Capital Group
chains.finding: NOT VERIFIED. Site returns HTTP 403 to scripted requests. Whether a tenant directory exists behind it is unknown.
chains.recheck: Needs a browser session to get past the 403.

chains.name: Gaisano Grand Malls
chains.finding: VERIFIED. WordPress; branches are ordinary posts (slug gaisano-grand-mall-<place>) reachable via /wp-json/wp/v2/posts and a paginated /branches/ listing. Each branch post contains only ADDRESS, MALL HOURS (supermarket + department store) and PHONE NUMBER - no tenant list. These are department-store/supermarket-anchored retail centres, not tenant-leased malls.
chains.recheck: Branch list (~46) IS scrapeable today via the WP posts API if mall-level coverage is wanted.

chains.name: LCC Group (Bicol)
chains.finding: NOT VERIFIED. Serves a 4.6KB 'Redirecting...' bot-challenge shell to scripted requests (same WAF pattern as XentroMall's parked domain and Shangri-La's).

chains.name: LTS Malls
chains.finding: NOT VERIFIED. No official domain located; ltsmalls.com does not resolve. Search results conflate it with NCCC. Operator identity needs confirming before scraping.

chains.name: NCCC Malls
chains.finding: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. nccc.com.ph/business-unit/nccc-malls/ is a corporate business-unit page (company profile, vision/mission, press) with no tenant listing found. ~9 branches across Davao, Tagum and Palawan per their own copy. No per-mall directory URL located.
chains.recheck: Search for a separate consumer mall site before concluding no directory exists.

chains.name: Primark Town Centers (LKY Group)
chains.finding: ~45 provincial community centers exposed as WordPress pages named location-<place> (plus location-luzon-malls / -visayas-malls / -mindanao-malls index pages). Each page carries only a street address and leasing contact - no tenant list. Mall list IS obtainable from the WP REST API.
chains.recheck: Locations are scrapeable today if mall-level (not brand-level) coverage is ever wanted.

chains.name: Puregold Price Club
chains.finding: NOT a mall operator in this dataset's sense: each Puregold branch is a single supermarket/hypermarket, not a leased mall with a tenant roster. Adding ~400 branches would inject 400 'malls' each holding one 'tenant' (itself) and would badly skew brand-presence and mall-size analysis. /store-locator/ 404s; the correct locator path was not found before running out of budget.
chains.recheck: If wanted, model Puregold as a BRAND that appears inside other operators' malls (it already appears as a tenant), or add it with property_type='supermarket' and exclude it from mall comparisons.

chains.name: Shangri-La Plaza (Shang Properties)
chains.finding: Their official domain shangrila-plaza.com no longer resolves (no DNS), and shangrilaplaza.com.ph is a ParkLogic parked page offering the domain for sale. The only surviving official store listing is a Google Sites page at sites.google.com/view/shangcommunity/store-listing, which is explicitly stamped 'Updated as of February 02, 2021' - COVID-era data, five years stale. NOT scraped: importing 2021 tenants into a 2026 snapshot would silently corrupt month-over-month brand analysis.
chains.recheck: Watch for a relaunched Shang Properties mall site. The Google Sites listing IS parseable (same Google Sites structure as the Robinsons VMD parser) if stale data is ever acceptable for a one-off backfill.

chains.name: Vista Malls (Vista Land)
chains.finding: WordPress site with a page per mall and a /stores/<slug>/ route, but the store sections render only logo carousels - no tenant names in the markup. The dev mirror (dev.vistamalls.com.ph/<mall>/store/) still contains Lorem ipsum placeholders, so the directory was never populated. Mall list IS obtainable from the WP REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/pages).
chains.recheck: If /stores/<slug>/ ever renders named tenants, a scraper is trivial - the WP API already lists the malls.

chains.name: XentroMalls
chains.finding:
Scraped and then removed on 2026-07-27. Four of the 19 mall pages (montalban-town-center, tanay-town-center, xentro-mall-calapan, xentro-mall-lemery) list two tenants per line with no delimiter, e.g.
  • Jollibee Auto Sonix Watch Store
    • . Verified at byte level: no inner markup, no non-breaking space, no repeated space. No cleaner source exists - wp-json returns an empty content.rendered because the content lives in page-builder post meta, /wp/v2/pages//revisions is 401, and a browser trace shows no XHR for the tenant list. Separately, 16 of 19 pages were last modified 2019-02-11, so the directories are years stale.
chains.recheck: Re-add if the site is rebuilt with one tenant per list item, or if a tenant API appears. Check wp-json/wp/v2/pages modified dates first: unchanged dates mean the directories are still stale.

notes: megaworldlifestylemalls.com (no hyphen) has lapsed and now redirects to an unrelated ad/scam domain. The live Megaworld site is megaworld-lifestylemalls.com - do not re-add the old domain.
filinvestmalls.com is a parked lander; the live Filinvest site is filinvestlifemalls.com.
Festival Mall is not a separate operator - it is Filinvest's flagship and is covered by the filinvest scraper.
Starmall and Vista Mall are both Vista Land brands but are separate sites; only Starmall publishes tenant directories.
Filinvest's IL CORSO directory lists only 19 shops, which is sparse for a mall of its size - an upstream data limitation, not a parse failure (verified against raw table row counts).

WalterMart IS scraped: waltermart.com.ph is behind an sgcaptcha challenge, but the malls.waltermart.com.ph subdomain serves plain HTML with no challenge. The per-mall category pages cap at 10 tenants, so the scraper reads the uncapped chain-wide /stores/ index and each store's /api/stores/<id>/ branch list instead (routes found in the Django debug 404 URLconf).
xentromall.com.ph is a parked domain; the live XentroMalls site is www.xentromalls.com.
XentroMall Antipolo, Polangui and ShopKing publish only the leasing-requirements checklist on their locator pages, no tenant list - their zero counts are an upstream gap, verified.

WalterMart Mabalacat, San Pascual and Silang return zero stores legitimately: their category pages carry only the empty store-detail modal template and no a.wm-store tenant anchors. Verified against the live site 2026-07 - upstream gap, not a parse failure.

All 12 zero-store malls in the snapshot are VERIFIED upstream gaps, not parse failures (audited 2026-07-27): ayala-vermosa (explore=false); cybergate-bacolod (page, no directory); SM la-union/zamboanga/makati (API returns counts:0); WalterMart mabalacat/san-pascual/silang (empty store-detail modal, no tenant anchors); Xentro antipolo/polangui/shopking (leasing checklist only); Megaworld tuscany-at-mckinley-hill (Contentstack reports 0 tenants referencing it).
